verdict_reason: The record correctly normalises absent, null and blank filters (covered by AddressServiceTest), but its searchTerm component reuses ListCriteria.SearchTerm's name for a narrower concept.

todos.issue: The component searchTerm (lines 11, 16, 22) is the free-text q only, but ListCriteria.SearchTerm (ListCriteria.java:22), new in the same PR, is any one way to match the search: text, countries or roles. AddressService.searchTermsOf (AddressService.java:99) reads requested.searchTerm() and also turns countryCodes and searchRoles into 'search terms', so one name means two different things one call apart.
todos.fix: Must: the free-text query and the union of search alternatives carry different names across RequestedListFilters, ListCriteria and AddressService. One way: rename the component to searchText (matching ListCriteria.TextMatching) and its Javadoc to 'the user's search text, trimmed; empty for no search'.
